description: PAID (needs a key) — Use when your user wants the companies of a market as a list, after count_companies sized it. 0.25 credits per company delivered (25 companies = 6.25 credits): the companies a count_companies question found, into a company list in ListPlus — name, domain, website, industry, size, place, LinkedIn page. 10, 25, 50 per call (`limit`), a cursor for the next ones. The same page within an hour costs nothing again. estimate:true shows the price (free, no key).

cursor.description: From the last answer: the next companies into the same list

estimate.description: true = the filters as understood and the price, nothing runs (free, no key)

filters.description: Company filters. Copy the exact values of each from search_options { for: "companies", category: "<the filter's name>" }

categories.description: Business models, e.g. b2b, saas, e-commerce

company_types.description: Company types, e.g. private, public, nonprofit

countries.description: Countries as ISO codes, e.g. US, DE

departments.description: Has a team of at least 5 in each of these departments

exclude.description: Values a company must NOT have — the same keys as the pick filters above

founded_max.description: Founded in or before this year

founded_min.description: Founded in or after this year

growth.description: Head count change over 12 months (one value: shrinking, stable, growing, fast)

keywords.description: Words describing what the company does (free text); all must fit unless keywords_any

keywords_any.description: true = any of the keywords is enough

name_contains.description: Part of the company's name or domain

reported_employees.description: Head count classes as the company reports them

states.description: States / regions of ONE country (ids; needs exactly one country)

team.description: A department's head count between min and max

department.description: search_options category team_departments ("overall" = the whole company)

max.description: At most this many people in it

min.description: At least this many people in it

department.description: search_options category team_departments ("overall" = the whole company)

min_percent.description: Grew by at least this many percent (negative = shrank at most)

technologies.description: Technologies on the company's website, e.g. Shopify, HubSpot; all must fit unless technologies_any

technologies_any.description: true = any of the technologies is enough

list_id.description: Append to this list of the workspace (default: a new list per search)

max_credits.description: The most this call may cost; it loads fewer pages / refuses rather than spend more

name: load_companies
title: Load companies
